package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

// scenario for env_or_config_lookup_per_request: Environment variable reads observed on request paths instead of cached configuration.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
type Rule311PositiveHandler struct {
	secret string
}

func (h *Rule311PositiveHandler) CreateUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	dbURL := os.Getenv("DB_URL")
	if dbURL == "" {
		http.Error(w, "DB_URL not set", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	apiKey := os.Getenv("API_KEY")
	if apiKey == "" {
		http.Error(w, "API_KEY not set", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	_ = dbURL
	_ = apiKey
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"created"}`))
}
